title: Nova Swarm A.R.C.
tagline: Follow the stars. Mine the ore. Get your crew to G-47.
description: An arcade formation shooter with a crew comedy. Story is a five-level campaign with Officer Vale and Captain Rourke: each level is a swarm round followed by a 3D corridor run through rocks, ore and alien fighters, with the Southern Ring boss in level 5 and the landing on G-47 at the end. Corridor Run is the endless Ash Run corridor (2D on devices without WebGL).
credit: Game by Jerm747. Sky images: NASA, ESA, CSA, STScI.
